;; Allocation is distinct from backing storage and reachability. Releasing zero
;; incoming owners cascades; unreachable cycles survive until cycle collection.
syntax hedge = HEDGE pnode pnode
syntax hgraph = { NODES pnode*, EDGES hedge*, ROOTS pnode* }
var H : hgraph

dec $heap_member(pnode, pnode*) : bool
def $heap_member(pnode, eps) = false
def $heap_member(pnode, pnode :: pnode_tail*) = true
def $heap_member(pnode, pnode_other :: pnode_tail*) = $heap_member(pnode, pnode_tail*)
  -- if pnode =/= pnode_other

dec $heap_count(pnode, pnode*) : nat
def $heap_count(pnode, eps) = 0
def $heap_count(pnode, pnode :: pnode_tail*) = $(1 + $heap_count(pnode, pnode_tail*))
def $heap_count(pnode, pnode_other :: pnode_tail*) = $heap_count(pnode, pnode_tail*)
  -- if pnode =/= pnode_other

dec $heap_unique(pnode*) : bool
def $heap_unique(eps) = true
def $heap_unique(pnode :: pnode_tail*) = (~$heap_member(pnode, pnode_tail*) /\ $heap_unique(pnode_tail*))

dec $heap_subset(pnode*, pnode*) : bool
def $heap_subset(eps, pnode_alloc*) = true
def $heap_subset(pnode :: pnode_tail*, pnode_alloc*) = ($heap_member(pnode, pnode_alloc*) /\ $heap_subset(pnode_tail*, pnode_alloc*))

dec $heap_edges_valid(hedge*, pnode*) : bool
def $heap_edges_valid(eps, pnode*) = true
def $heap_edges_valid((HEDGE pnode_from pnode_to) :: hedge_tail*, pnode*) = ($heap_member(pnode_from, pnode*) /\ $heap_member(pnode_to, pnode*) /\ $heap_edges_valid(hedge_tail*, pnode*))

dec $heap_valid(hgraph) : bool
def $heap_valid(H) = ($heap_unique(H.NODES) /\ $heap_subset(H.ROOTS, H.NODES) /\ $heap_edges_valid(H.EDGES, H.NODES))

dec $heap_edge_owners(pnode, hedge*, pnode*) : nat
def $heap_edge_owners(pnode, eps, pnode_alloc*) = 0
def $heap_edge_owners(pnode, (HEDGE pnode_from pnode) :: hedge_tail*, pnode_alloc*) = $(1 + $heap_edge_owners(pnode, hedge_tail*, pnode_alloc*))
  -- if $heap_member(pnode_from, pnode_alloc*)
def $heap_edge_owners(pnode, (HEDGE pnode_from pnode_to) :: hedge_tail*, pnode_alloc*) = $heap_edge_owners(pnode, hedge_tail*, pnode_alloc*)
  -- if (pnode =/= pnode_to \/ ~$heap_member(pnode_from, pnode_alloc*))

dec $heap_owners(hgraph, pnode) : nat
def $heap_owners(H, pnode) = $($heap_count(pnode, H.ROOTS) + $heap_edge_owners(pnode, H.EDGES, H.NODES))

dec $heap_retained(hgraph, pnode*) : pnode*
def $heap_retained(H, eps) = eps
def $heap_retained(H, pnode :: pnode_tail*) = pnode :: $heap_retained(H, pnode_tail*)
  -- if $($heap_owners(H, pnode) > 0)
def $heap_retained(H, pnode :: pnode_tail*) = $heap_retained(H, pnode_tail*)
  -- if $heap_owners(H, pnode) = 0

dec $heap_live_edges(hedge*, pnode*) : hedge*
def $heap_live_edges(eps, pnode*) = eps
def $heap_live_edges((HEDGE pnode_from pnode_to) :: hedge_tail*, pnode*) = (HEDGE pnode_from pnode_to) :: $heap_live_edges(hedge_tail*, pnode*)
  -- if ($heap_member(pnode_from, pnode*) /\ $heap_member(pnode_to, pnode*))
def $heap_live_edges((HEDGE pnode_from pnode_to) :: hedge_tail*, pnode*) = $heap_live_edges(hedge_tail*, pnode*)
  -- if (~$heap_member(pnode_from, pnode*) \/ ~$heap_member(pnode_to, pnode*))

dec $heap_prune(hgraph) : hgraph
def $heap_prune(H) = H[.EDGES = $heap_live_edges(H.EDGES, H.NODES)]
  -- if $heap_retained(H, H.NODES) = H.NODES
def $heap_prune(H) = $heap_prune(H[.NODES = pnode*])
  -- if pnode* = $heap_retained(H, H.NODES)
  -- if pnode* =/= H.NODES

;; Collection is a separate pure graph operation, not a PHP GC trigger or a
;; gc_collect_cycles return-count implementation. Order preserves allocation IDs.
dec $heap_children(pnode, hedge*) : pnode*
dec $heap_reach(pnode*, pnode*, hedge*) : pnode*
def $heap_reach(eps, pnode_seen*, hedge*) = pnode_seen*
def $heap_reach(pnode :: pnode_work*, pnode_seen*, hedge*) = $heap_reach(pnode_work*, pnode_seen*, hedge*)
  -- if $heap_member(pnode, pnode_seen*)
def $heap_reach(pnode :: pnode_work*, pnode_seen*, hedge*) = $heap_reach($heap_children(pnode, hedge*) ++ pnode_work*, pnode :: pnode_seen*, hedge*)
  -- if ~$heap_member(pnode, pnode_seen*)

def $heap_children(pnode, eps) = eps
def $heap_children(pnode, (HEDGE pnode pnode_to) :: hedge_tail*) = pnode_to :: $heap_children(pnode, hedge_tail*)
def $heap_children(pnode, (HEDGE pnode_other pnode_to) :: hedge_tail*) = $heap_children(pnode, hedge_tail*)
  -- if pnode =/= pnode_other

dec $heap_intersect(pnode*, pnode*) : pnode*
def $heap_intersect(eps, pnode_seen*) = eps
def $heap_intersect(pnode :: pnode_tail*, pnode_seen*) = pnode :: $heap_intersect(pnode_tail*, pnode_seen*)
  -- if $heap_member(pnode, pnode_seen*)
def $heap_intersect(pnode :: pnode_tail*, pnode_seen*) = $heap_intersect(pnode_tail*, pnode_seen*)
  -- if ~$heap_member(pnode, pnode_seen*)

dec $heap_collect(hgraph) : hgraph
def $heap_collect(H) = H[.NODES = pnode_live*][.EDGES = $heap_live_edges(H.EDGES, pnode_live*)]
  -- if pnode_live* = $heap_intersect(H.NODES, $heap_reach(H.ROOTS, eps, H.EDGES))

;; recompiles their children nor changes the first quiet access records.

dec $ppcoalescethis(ppstate, expression) : ppstate
dec $ppmemo_at(ppexprdone*, pcpath) : (nat, pvalue?)?

dec $ppwritedone(ppstate, pcpath) : ppstate

def $pptemporary(NExprAssignOpCoalesce expression_1 expression_2 metadata) = true
def $ppdispatch(P, pcpath, NExprAssignOpCoalesce expression_1 expression_2 metadata, PPR) = $ppcoalesceassign($ppcoalescethis($ppupdatecheck(P, expression_1), expression_1), pcpath, expression_1, expression_2)
def $ppcoalescethis(P, expression) = P
  -- if P.COMPLETION =/= PPCNORMAL
def $ppcoalescethis(P, NExprVariable phpType32 metadata) = $ppcheck(P, $context_error("Cannot re-assign $this", P.LOCATION.LINE))
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL
  -- if $cv_name(phpType32) = ([116,104,105,115])
def $ppcoalescethis(P, expression) = P -- otherwise

def $ppcoalesceassign(P, pcpath, expression_1, expression_2) = $ppclearvalue($pprefetch($ppassignright($ppexpr(P, pcpath ++ [PCFIELD 0], expression_1, PPIS), pcpath, expression_1, expression_2, false), pcpath ++ [PCFIELD 0], expression_1))

def $ppmemo_at(eps, pcpath) = eps

def $ppmemo(P, pcpath, expression) = P
  -- if P.COMPLETION =/= PPCNORMAL
def $ppmemo(P, pcpath, expression) = $pplocate(P[.FOLD = P.FOLD[.VALUE = pvalue?]], pcpath, $expression_line(expression))
  -- if P.COMPLETION = PPCNORMAL
  -- if $ppmemo_at(P.EXPRESSIONS, pcpath) = ((n, pvalue?))

def $ppmemo(P, pcpath, expression) = $ppunsupported(P, "missing memoized operand descriptor")

  -- if $ppmemo_at(P.EXPRESSIONS, pcpath) = eps

def $pprefetch(P, pcpath, expression) = P
  -- if P.COMPLETION =/= PPCNORMAL
def $pprefetch(P, pcpath, expression) = $ppwritedone($pprefetchbody($pplocate(P, pcpath, $expression_line(expression)), pcpath, expression), pcpath)

def $pprefetchbody(P, pcpath, expression) = P
  -- if P.COMPLETION =/= PPCNORMAL
def $pprefetchbody(P, pcpath, NExprVariable phpType32 metadata) = $pprefetchname(P, pcpath, phpType32)

  -- if ~$ppglobals_base(expression)

  -- if $ppglobals_base(expression_base)
def $pprefetchbody(P, pcpath, expression) = $ppcheck(P, $context_error("Cannot use temporary expression in write context", P.LOCATION.LINE))

  -- if $pptemporary(expression)
